name: CineStill 800T
notes: CineStill 800T = Kodak Vision3 500T (5219) with remjet removed, rated ~EI 800 in C-41. H&D approx from Kodak E-4050 / H-1-5219 Vision3 500T Status M curves; straight-line gamma ≈ 0.55 (motion-picture negative aim). logE = 0 at ISO speed point (D ≈ 0.15 above fog). Spectral crosstalk reasoned from Vision3 500T tungsten-balanced sensitivity plots (red layer weighted for 3200 K; modest G↔R and G↔B overlap). DIR strength at pro/motion-picture level. Halation intentionally strong — no remjet anti-halation layer is the stock's signature red highlight glow. RMS granularity 7 from Vision3 500T datasheet Diffuse RMS Granularity. Curves/matrices are faithful memory approximations of the published plots, not point-digitized from a scanned datasheet PDF.
